title: elatostema platyphyllum var. balansae
intro: Elatostema platyphyllum var. balansae, commonly known as Balansa's Elatostema, is a type of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elatostema platyphyllum var. balansae include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of various diseases, such as fever and cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
